description: Defines the IsolationInfo class used for managing network request context and security policies in Chromium's networking stack. Includes enums, constructors, serialization, and related methods.

classes.name: IsolationInfo
classes.description: Manages network request context, including origins, request type, and cookie policies, with serialization and deserialization capabilities.

methods.name: CreateForInternalRequest
methods.description: Creates an internal request IsolationInfo with specified top frame origin.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes an IsolationInfo from a string.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo with specified parameters, ensuring consistency.

methods.name: CreateIfConsistent
methods.description: Creates an IsolationInfo if parameters are consistent.

methods.name: CreateForRedirect
methods.description: Creates a new IsolationInfo for a redirect to a new origin.

methods.name: ToDoUseTopFrameOriginAsWell
methods.description: Temporary method for handling incorrect usage of frame origin.
